messages:
maya: FYI Acme reported ~10 min of 502s this morning after our scheduled cert rotation ran earlier than their expected window. Suspect rotator timezone handling.

samir: timeline? what rotated and when (rotator logs + haproxy logs please).

maya: attaching snippets below. rotator log shows job scheduled at local server TZ, not UTC: 
```
rotator: INFO starting rotation for acme-app
rotator: INFO compute next run: 2026-03-15T02:00:00-04:00
rotator: INFO uploading cert /bundle.pem
rotator: INFO triggering proxy reload
```

haproxy log at reload: 
```
Mar 15 06:01:12 haproxy[998]: Server acme_app/0 DOWN 502 SSL handshake failure (depth=1) - incomplete certificate chain
Mar 15 06:01:15 haproxy[998]: Server acme_app/0 UP
```

openssl s_client against private endpoint during incident: 
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
140535...: TLSv1.3 alert: unknown_ca
1405...: Verify return code: 20 (unable to get local issuer certificate)
```

maya: customer is on UTC+4; our host in UTC, but rotator was using host local tz when scheduling. For them rotation landed earlier than agreed and they hadn't preloaded intermediate bundle on their end.

joel: that aligns — we saw another near-miss last month but it was transient. code pointer: rotator uses github.com/robfig/cron without explicit CRON_TZ by default. in Go we do `time.Now().Location()` during schedule compute.

samir: can we repro? steps?

joel: repro steps I used: 
1) docker run -e TZ=America/Los_Angeles ./rotator --dry-run 
2) schedule set to `0 2 * * *` (intended as 02:00 UTC) 
3) rotator logs show 02:00-07:00-04:00 style offsets (local tz).

joel: failing code snippet: 
```
// uses local timezone implicitly
schedTime := time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339)
cronExpr := computeCron(schedTime)
c := cron.New()
c.AddFunc(cronExpr, rotate)
```

samir: immediate mitigation?

maya: rolled back to previous certificate bundle at 2065432260 using ops-bot. ops-bot confirmed reload success. 

ops-bot: Rolled back cert for acme-app to previous-bundle (sha: a1b2c3) and reloaded proxy at 2065432260 :white_check_mark:

maya: customer back online after rollback. they requested root cause and permanent fix.

samir: planned fix: 
- enforce CRON_TZ=UTC in rotator env and set cron library to parse in UTC 
- patch code to use time.UTC() when computing run windows 
- add unit + e2e test for timezone edge cases (DST + tz offsets) 
- add pre-rotation check: verify intermediate chain present on proxy before reload (fail safe)

joel: also add audit log entry in console showing rotation scheduled in UTC and local tz conversion visible to customers.

infra-bot: Created follow-up ticket TICKET-4321: rotator timezone scheduling bug + pre-rotation chain check. Assignee: samir. Due: 2026-03-20.

samir: will open PR today, aim for canary deploy to staging and add an integration test that runs cron in a different TZ.

maya: customer notified; asked for RCA and ETA. i'll attach ticket and timeline.

samir: quick workaround for support docs: instruct customers to pre-upload full chain and verify via `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect <host>:443` before rotation window. add snippet below.
```
openssl s_client -showcerts -connect acme-host:443 | sed -n '/BEGIN/,/END/p'
```

maya: follow-ups: samir owns the fix + PR, joel adds tests, i'll run postmortem with customer next Tue. ops-bot will close when PR merged + staging validated.

maya: tagging @sre for visibility :eyes:
